title: Maintenance Technician
text:
Maintenance Technician
About Haldane
Haldane Group makes packaging, food ingredients and machine parts in 6 plants across Belgium.
Our plants run on SAP.
Your role
You find the cause of faults in wiring, motors and control cabinets.
You will work daily with PLC programming and keep TIA Portal projects up to date.
You plan inspections and part replacements before machines break down.
Your profile
No prior experience with welding is required.
You can read electrical schematics.
You speak fluent Dutch; French is a plus.
Nice to have
Experience with hydraulics is a plus.
Knowledge of root cause analysis would be nice.
What we offer
A permanent contract in a stable company.
Training in lean manufacturing.
Questions? Contact Ann Peeters, our HR partner.

title: Onderhoudstechnicus (m/v/x)
text:
Onderhoudstechnicus (m/v/x)
Over Haldane
Haldane Group maakt verpakkingen, voedingsingrediënten en machineonderdelen in 6 fabrieken in België.
Veiligheid staat voorop op elke Haldane-site.
Jouw rol
Je zoekt de oorzaak van fouten in bekabeling, motoren en schakelkasten.
Je programmeert en past de sturingen aan die onze productielijnen aandrijven.
Je herstelt cilinders, ventielen en persluchtcircuits op onze machines.
Jouw profiel
Je hebt een BA4-attest en leest technische tekeningen.
Ervaring met lassen is geen vereiste.
Je spreekt vlot Nederlands.
Pluspunten
Kennis van Frans is mooi meegenomen.
Wat wij bieden
Een vast contract in een stabiel bedrijf.
Een VCA-opleiding in je eerste maand.
Vragen? Neem contact op met Ann Peeters, onze HR-partner.

title: Maintenance Engineer
text:
Maintenance Engineer
About Haldane
Haldane Group makes packaging, food ingredients and machine parts in 6 plants across Belgium.
All our plants are ISO 9001 certified.
You are a digital native.
What you will do
You take ownership of MIG/MAG for the site.
You program and adjust the controllers that drive our production lines.
You use CNC to support the team.
Your profile
You speak fluent French.
You find the cause of faults in wiring, motors and control cabinets.
Good knowledge of English is required.
You know your way around hydraulics and planned maintenance.
No prior experience with shift leader is required.
Bonus points
Knowledge of Six Sigma would be nice.
Knowledge of root cause analysis would be nice.
Our offer
A permanent contract in a stable company.
Mentoring by an experienced colleague.
Questions? Contact Lucas Dubois, our HR partner.

title: Accountmanager (m/v/x)
text:
Accountmanager (m/v/x)
Over Haldane
Haldane is een industriële familiegroep met 5 sites in Vlaanderen en Wallonië.
Ons IT-platform draait op AWS.
Je bent maximaal 30 jaar.
Jouw rol
Je houdt elk klantcontact en elke opportuniteit up-to-date in ons verkoopsysteem.
Je werkt dagelijks met Nederlands.
Vereisten
Je hebt minstens 2 jaar ervaring met Key account management.
Je hebt ervaring met prospectie en onderhandelingsvaardigheden.
Kennis van inkoop is niet nodig.
Een plus
Kennis van presentatievaardigheden is mooi meegenomen.
Ervaring met voorraadbeheer is een pluspunt.
Ons aanbod
Een vast contract in een stabiel bedrijf.
Vragen? Neem contact op met Fatima El Amrani, onze HR-partner.

title: Data Engineer
text:
Data Engineer
Haldane is a family-owned industrial group with 4 sites in Flanders and Wallonia.
We are proud of our lean culture.
Recent graduates are preferred.
You use Dutch to support the team.
Good knowledge of English is required.
You bring experience in hypothesis testing and PyTorch.
You are comfortable working with predictive modeling.
You build interactive reports that show managers their KPIs at a glance.
Familiarity with data modelling is a bonus.
Knowledge of Git would be nice.
Experience with Java is a plus.
Flexible hours and 32 days off.
Questions? Contact Lucas Dubois, our HR partner.

title: Full-stack Developer
text:
Full-stack Developer
About Haldane
Haldane Group makes packaging, food ingredients and machine parts in 5 plants across Belgium.
Food safety is non-negotiable in our ingredient plants.
What you will do
You will work daily with Agile / Scrum.
You define the HTTP interfaces through which our systems exchange data.
You keep the code history clean with short-lived branches and reviewed merges.
What you bring
You bring experience in SQL Server and GitHub Actions.
You are comfortable working with unit testing.
Bonus points
Knowledge of machine learning would be nice.
What we offer
Flexible hours and 32 days off.
Personal coaching and a training budget.
Questions? Contact Mohamed Benali, our HR partner.

title: Supply chain planner (m/v/x)
text:
Supply chain planner (m/v/x)
Over Haldane
Haldane is een industriële familiegroep met 6 sites in Vlaanderen en Wallonië.
Onze fabrieken draaien op SAP.
Takenpakket
Je bent verantwoordelijk voor cycle counting op de site.
Je beslist welke vrachtwagen welke leveringen in welke volgorde rijdt.
Hij rapporteert aan de plantmanager.
Jouw profiel
Je hebt minstens 2 jaar ervaring met aankoop.
Praktische ervaring met Supply chain planning.
Je spreekt vlot Duits.
Ervaring met voedselveiligheid is geen vereiste.
Een plus
Je controleert stalen van elke batch tegen de specificaties en blokkeert wat afwijkt.
Je beslist welke orders wanneer op welke lijn lopen, zodat deadlines gehaald worden.
Ons aanbod
Flexibele uren en 32 verlofdagen.
Vragen? Neem contact op met Mohamed Benali, onze HR-partner.

title: Financial Controller
text:
Financial Controller
Haldane Group makes packaging, food ingredients and machine parts in 4 plants across Belgium.
All our plants are ISO 9001 certified.
You close the books every month and present the figures to management.
You analyse cost per product and explain variances to plant managers.
You are at home in spreadsheets with lookups, pivots and macros.
You have at least 4 years of experience with financial modelling.
You are comfortable working with budget control.
You know your way around invoice processing and PRINCE2.
Good knowledge of English is required.
No prior experience with performance management is required.
You keep employee records and HR workflows correct in our HR software.
Familiarity with coaching is a bonus.
A competitive salary, meal vouchers and a company car.
A VCA course in your first month.
Questions? Contact Fatima El Amrani, our HR partner.
